about_the_game:
Naughty plunges you into a chilling Christmas nightmare as you search a snowbound neighborhood for missing children and lost presents. Solve twisted puzzles, uncover dark secrets, and survive the hunt of a monstrous Krampus. Escape his judgement… or be claimed by the Naughty List.

Step into the shoes of Alexander, a haunted private investigator drawn to a snowbound subdivision on Christmas Eve, searching for children gone missing and answers from his own tragic past.

Explore an eerie, abandoned neighborhood blanketed in a relentless blizzard that limits your vision and raises the stakes.

Solve intricate puzzles to find lost presents scattered throughout the neighborhood. Each one bringing you closer to breaking the curse

Uncover chilling secrets hidden beneath the quiet snow, revealing a dark presence connected to the mysterious Naughty List.

Evade and outsmart the monstrous Krampus, a twisted force hunting you through the shadows and snowdrifts.

Experience a haunting narrative that blends psychological horror with festive dread, where every choice could be your last.

Survive long enough to escape… or become the next name carved into the Naughty List.

You are Alexander, a private investigator haunted by the disappearance of your wife, Emma, exactly one year ago on Christmas Eve. After a freak car accident on a snowy night, you heard the faint ringing of bells and heavy footsteps approaching—then suddenly she vanished from your side without a trace. There was no body, no answers, only memories that refused to fade.

Now, on the anniversary of that night, you’ve been called to investigate a quiet, snowbound subdivision on the outskirts of town where several children have gone missing. The case feels disturbingly familiar. Driven by hope and desperation, you take it not just as a detective but as a husband searching for the truth.

What you find is chilling. Not a soul can be found. Only frozen toys and abandoned homes swallowed by silence. All whilst something wicked watches from the shadows.

As you dig deeper, the malevolent presence stalking the neighborhood reveals its true horror. You are certain the nightmare here is connected to the night that shattered your life. To survive, you must recover the lost gifts, confront your buried past, and unravel the mystery of the Naughty List before your name is carved into it.
